description: For ALL canvas content (charts, games, graphs). Use 'get_image' to read pixels, 'draw' to simulate gestures. Do NOT use browser_click here.

action.description: 'get_image' — exports the canvas as a base64 image so you can analyze its visual content (prices, chart patterns, etc). 'draw' — simulates drag/pointer events across canvas points (for drawing, selecting regions, etc).

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

backendNodeId.description: Raw CDP backendNodeId for direct targeting.

id.description: Ref ID from browser_map (e.g. 'w:42') for the canvas element.

label.description: Visible text or aria-label of the canvas element.

points.description: Array of {x,y} points relative to canvas viewport for 'draw' action. Simulates a drag path across the canvas.

ref.description: Alternative ref identifier for the canvas element.

selector.description: CSS Selector for the target <canvas> element. Use 'canvas' to select the first canvas on the page, or a more specific selector like 'canvas#chart'.

name: browser_canvas
